raw.query: WITH pairs(policy, arm, sim_run_id) AS (VALUES ('forecast'::text, 'live_fc'::text, 'live:twin_fc_p90'::text), ('reactive'::text, 'live_re'::text, 'live:twin_re'::text)) SELECT p.policy, l.ttft_p99_ms AS client_ttft_p99_ms, i.achieved_p99_ms AS simulated_ttft_p99_ms, ABS(l.ttft_p99_ms - i.achieved_p99_ms) / i.achieved_p99_ms * 100.0 AS point_difference_pct, l.request_count AS client_request_count, i.n_requests AS simulated_request_count, d_live.run_id AS client_run_id, d_sim.run_id AS simulated_run_id, d_live.superseded_by AS client_superseded_by, d_sim.superseded_by AS simulated_superseded_by FROM pairs p JOIN provenance.v_live_anchor l ON l.arm = p.arm JOIN provenance.v_dim d_live ON d_live.run_id = 'live:arm:' || p.arm AND d_live.is_current = TRUE JOIN provenance.v_infraction i ON i.run_id = p.sim_run_id AND i.is_current = TRUE AND i.sla_metric = 'ttft' AND i.bound_stat = 'p99' JOIN provenance.v_dim d_sim ON d_sim.run_id = i.run_id AND d_sim.is_current = TRUE WHERE d_live.superseded_by IS NULL AND d_sim.superseded_by IS NULL ORDER BY p.policy
raw.claimed: 1.1--6.8%, with a single live run per policy and interpreted as a point difference rather than a repeated-run noise band.
raw.evidence: The current, unsuperseded client and simulation records differ by 1.0509360604367979% for reactive and 6.760576040692199% for forecast, which round to 1.1% and 6.8%; one client record is present for each policy.
